author: Exdeath
what_it_is: Very end of game before crater, all characters 99, 99 of every item, best materia in every slot, all Master Materias
format: DexDrive .gme cut short: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header + only the first 122880 bytes of the card (15 of 16 blocks); the card holds 14 save(s), 1 for this game (BASCUS-94163FF7-S02)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr final-fantasy-vii.3218.gme: unwraps the card (DexDrive .gme: 3904-byte header + card (only 122880 card bytes, zero-padded to 131072))

beetle-psx.detail: Slot 1 lists file 2: Cloud, Level 99, 30:37, Junon Area

beetle-psx-hw.detail: Slot 1 lists file 2: Cloud, Level 99, 30:37, Junon Area (the same screen as on beetle-psx)

pcsx-rearmed.detail: Slot 1 lists file 2: Cloud, Level 99, 30:37, Junon Area (the same screen as on beetle-psx)

swanstation.detail: Slot 1 lists file 2: Cloud, Level 99, 30:37, Junon Area (the same screen as on beetle-psx)

duckstation.detail: not runnable here: no macOS build of the DuckStation libretro core

psx-mister.detail: not runnable here: a MiSTer FPGA core

note: The converter pads the missing blocks with zeroes, as DuckStation's ImportCardGME does; the saves on the card all lie in the blocks present. one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: a PS1 memory card is 131072 bytes, or that behind a DexDrive, VGS or PSP header, but this file is 126784 bytes
